name: Infinite Guard doubles the Temporal spells and halves their cost (#2182)
contract: Infinite Guard 574312's tooltip reads "Increases the effectiveness of your Temporal Resilience, Temporal Swiftness, and Temporal Restoration spells by $s1% and reduces their mana costs by $s2%." In Spell.dbc both effects are SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) on EffectSpellClassMask [0,0,67108864], which inside SpellFamilyName 28 selects Temporal Resilience (536258-536263, 680389), Temporal Swiftness (680390) and Temporal Restoration (680456): Effect[0] EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) with EffectBasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100%, Effect[1] EffectMiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) with EffectBasePoints -51 + DieSides 1 = -50%. The authored effect values are Temporal Resilience armor 49+1=50, Temporal Swiftness haste-from-Spirit 9+1=10 and magic-duration -26+1=-25, Temporal Restoration mana-regen-from-Spirit 24+1=25 and in-combat share 24+1=25; SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS doubles each through Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp). All three carry ManaCostPercentage 24, and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST after resolving that percentage into an absolute number (SpellInfo.cpp), so the cost halves. Generic core machinery. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
